summary: In the podcast "Tech Flash," hosts Camille and Luc explain the learning pipeline of modern AI models, progressing from pre-training (reading the internet for general language skills) to fine-tuning (specializing via transfer learning, illustrated by how an English-expert model quickly picks up French). They then introduce in-context learning (ICL) as a newer, more flexible approach that leverages expanded context windows to give the model task-specific information on the fly, rather than requiring retraining.
